req.title: Update only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to update a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The violation is that test[4] has kind=negative but heuristic=STC. The STC (State Transition Coverage) heuristic is not restricted to negative tests, but the rule-based verifier flags the combination. The fix is to change test[4]'s heuristic from STC to NEG, which is consistent with its negative kind (a non-author attempting a GET on the update endpoint and receiving 403). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_author_can_update_own_post_returns_2xx():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 403
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

test_author_can_update_own_post_returns_2xx()
